samsung_account.title: Samsung Account login
samsung_account.description:
Sign in with the Samsung Account that owns the fridge. The integration will keep itself logged in automatically (re-authenticates on every 401 — no manual token rotation).

Required fields:

• **Samsung Account email / password** — the credentials you use at account.samsung.com.

  ⚠ Accounts with 2FA/MFA enabled are NOT supported by the underlying library. Disable 2FA temporarily, or use a sub-account without 2FA for just this integration.

• **signin_client_id** and **signin_client_secret** — these identify the integration as a SmartThings mobile-app client when talking to Samsung's login endpoint. They are NOT your Samsung Account; they're OAuth2 client credentials baked into the SmartThings Android APK. You must extract them once:

  1. Download any recent SmartThings APK (e.g. from apkmirror.com)
  2. Run `jadx -d out smartthings.apk`
  3. Grep for the strings: `grep -rE 'signin_client_id|OAUTH_CLIENT_ID' out/sources/`
  4. Paste the two values into the fields below.

• **device_id** (optional) — if left blank the integration will discover the FamilyHub fridge automatically.

pat.title: SmartThings Personal Access Token
pat.description: Tokens created after 2024-12-30 expire every 24 hours. You will need to reauthenticate after each expiry. This mode does NOT enable the camera feed — use Samsung Account login for that.
